title: Gartner® Research Explores the Evolution of Co-Managed Threat Detection Services and Why Organizations Are Embracing a Co-Managed Model
content_md: Security leaders have long faced what looked like a two-way choice: build and run every piece of security operations in-house, or hand significant operational responsibility to a managed security provider. That choice has been loosening.
